description: This file defines a custom layout manager class 'CustomToolbarLayout' that extends FlowLayout, providing customized size calculations for layout purposes in a Java Swing application.

classes.name: CustomToolbarLayout
classes.description: A custom layout manager extending FlowLayout with overridden size calculation methods for layout management.

methods.name: CustomToolbarLayout
methods.description: Constructors for CustomToolbarLayout with different parameter options.

methods.description: Calculates the minimum size needed for the layout based on the largest component.

methods.description: Calculates the preferred size for the layout.

methods.description: Computes the size of the container based on component sizes and layout logic.
